run_bm_fps: run the bm_fps benchmark for farthest point sampling across cpu and cuda backends
benchmark_sample_farthest_points_naive: benchmark the naive python farthest point sampling implementation with varying batch and point cloud sizes
benchmark_sample_farthest_points: benchmark the optimized farthest point sampling implementation with large point clouds up to 18384 points
review_bm_fps: review the bm_fps function to understand test case generation using itertools.product for benchmark parameters
refactor_bm_fps: refactor the bm_fps benchmark to add new batch sizes point cloud dimensions or sampling counts
